name: Show Featured Thumbnails
author: Hatsuhito

sections.description:
Add a thumbnail column of featured images to the Posts and Pages list screens.
If a post has no featured image, you can assign one directly from the list view.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate “Show Featured Thumbnails” from the Plugins menu in the WordPress admin.
  3. A new thumbnail column will appear in the Posts and Pages list screens.
sections.faq:
How can I hide the thumbnail column?

Uncheck the “Image” column in the Screen Options at the top of the admin list screen, or deactivate the plugin.

Which post types are supported?

The Posts and Pages list screens.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Fix: the “Upload Image” link on the Posts and Pages lists now opens the media modal (the media scripts were not fully loaded on list screens).
  • Fix: reopening the media modal for another row no longer assigns the image to the previously clicked post.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.2.
  • Removed the unneeded load_plugin_textdomain() call (translations are loaded automatically since WordPress 4.6).
  • The readme is now written in English only.

1.0.1

  • Maintenance: tested up to WordPress 6.9; bumped minimum requirements to WP 6.0 / PHP 7.4.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: Added featured image thumbnails to Posts and Pages list. If no thumbnail exists, you can select one from the list.
